# ghost/thermocouples

Read and compare offline Thermocouples material and temperature-range references without hardware access

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/thermocouples
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/thermocouples open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/thermocouples select_type --device <serial> --param type=<type>
ghost skill run ghost/thermocouples list_types --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/thermocouples compare_types --device <serial> --param left=<left> --param right=<right>
ghost skill run ghost/thermocouples read_details --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the offline Thermocouples reference
- `select_type`: Show one of the five fully exposed thermocouple types
- `list_types`: List fully exposed reference type tabs and current selection
- `compare_types`: Read two thermocouple reference records, leaving the second selected
- `read_details`: Read native positive/negative metals and temperature range
